characters.name: Monk
characters.description: a skinny young bald human monk, an ordinary human man (not a troll, not a goblin), with pale peach human skin, small round human ears, a small human nose, normal human teeth and no tusks, big innocent eyes, a plain brown hooded robe and a rope belt, no armor, no leather vest
characters.negative_prompt: troll, goblin, orc, ogre, elf, green skin, grey skin, pointed ears, long ears, tusks, underbite, fangs, leather vest, studs, spikes, wristbands, armor

characters.name: Bartender
characters.description: a massive moss-green troll bartender with a prominent underbite, cracked tusks, a braided beard full of beer caps, a black leather vest and studded wristbands, chunky troll body, leather and studs

scenes.name: monk_meets_bartender
scenes.prompt: Inside the troll tavern, the skinny bald human monk with pale human skin and a brown hooded robe stands at the bar holding a small empty wooden mug while the massive moss-green troll bartender leans over the counter and pours glowing emerald beer from a huge barrel, warm amber firelight, smoke, shelves of skull-shaped mugs behind them.
scenes.motion_prompt: The bartender tilts the barrel and emerald beer starts foaming into the monk's mug while the monk watches with wide innocent eyes.
scenes.end_prompt: The monk's wooden mug is full to the brim with foaming glowing emerald beer, the bartender holds the tilted barrel above it and grins with his underbite, the monk smiles with wide happy eyes.
